title: The $Q$-polynomial triple-intersection vanishing conjecture
conclusion: Norm identity proves projection nonzero when q is nonzero, but q=0 only annihilates the diagonal seed. Need annihilation on every word in the six generators; no invariant-kernel proof.

title: Orbit length conjecture for iterated bridge sums of trees and complete graphs
conclusion: A bridge recurrence for two factors does not automatically compose: attaching the next factor changes the cyclic label scheduling in the already bridged graph. Need a return-map invariant controlling every initial labeling and proving the minimal return time N(N-1), rather than only a multiple of it.

title: Ferroni–Schröter's real-rootedness conjecture for Chow polynomials
conclusion: Berczi, Coron, Eur, Li publicly refute this exact assertion on 12 October 2026. Theorem C gives simple 3-connected rank-seven matroids Tr^7(M_q directsum M_q directsum U_1,1) whose ordinary Chow polynomial is not real-rooted for odd prime powers q>=47. Choose prime47. This directly negates all-matroid real-rootedness, with no inference from failures of a stronger property. Theorem B plus Theorem A and Corollary D supplies a separate non-log-concavity amplification route; nonnegative real-rooted polynomials are log-concave by Newton. Proof bodies describe flag counts and discriminant thresholds; this lane did not rerun those computations or audit every construction lemma.
